ssr.ui-layer-static-bypass.note: True ratio sits near 1.0; both sides take the same bypass path. Measured over 8 idle-machine runs at 40 samples: mean 0.97, sd 0.03. Same floor as the app bypass below: at this size a ratio measures the machine, not the code.

ssr.app-static-bypass.note: Both sides return without rendering, so the true ratio is near 1.1 - but at roughly 600ns a side, what a shared CI runner measures is its own scheduler. CI reported 2.19x on a change that cannot reach this path, the same way it reported 1.55x before the ratio was last raised. Raising it again would only move the next false failure, so the ratio is now read only when the baseline is above minBaselineNs; below that the absolute budgets carry the check, and 10000ns leaves 12x headroom over the ~780ns observed median.
